scope: Full CircuitJS element set, categorized searchable parts library, 366 upstream examples, simulation controls (speed/current speed/step/reset), Adjustable sliders, non-pausing edits and exports

structuralReview.notes: Parts library extends the left rack on demand; speed/step live inside the timebase; slider strip sits above the instrument console only when adjustables exist; examples are a page of the experiment book. No new top toolbar or persistent side panel.

blocked.DataRecorderElm: browser download only; the embedded iframe cannot download

loadableNotInRack.SubcircuitElm: needs a model; LM317/TL431 are in the rack
loadableNotInRack.ScopeElm: created by the floating scope entry (not offered)
